Delhi receives heavy rainfall, IMD issues red alert

Delhi recorded 61.4 mm of rainfall in a 24-hour period, prompting the India Meteorological Department (IMD) to issue a red alert for heavy showers. The alert also warned of strong winds and thunderstorms.
